stem.en: Kolkata and Chennai both lie near the Bay of Bengal. Kolkata's wettest months are July and August. Chennai's are October and November. What best explains the difference?

text.en: Different monsoons bring their heaviest rain

feedback.en: Yes. Different winds bring the rain, in different months.

text.en: Kolkata lies much higher above the sea

feedback.en: No. Kolkata is at 6 m and Chennai at 7 m.

text.en: Chennai gets no rain from June to September

feedback.en: No. It gets 36.4 cm in those months.

text.en: The south-west monsoon reaches Chennai in October

feedback.en: No. By October that monsoon is leaving India.

explanation.en: Kolkata gets its heaviest rain when the south-west monsoon is over the Ganga plain. Chennai gets its heaviest rain later, when north-east winds cross the Bay of Bengal and pick up moisture.

hints.en: Which monsoon blows in July and August?
Which monsoon blows in October and November?
